| `gates run` | Every form (B450): built-in, custom and formatter gates (pint and prettier check the supported Git files in argv batches), `repeat_new_tests` (changed sources add the tests that import them), light blocks, flaky detection and a run with no `--run` and no `--block`. A stop signal (SIGINT or SIGTERM) writes the same cancel rows. With `--run` and `--block` the B392 preflight runs first by default (`--no-preflight` skips it); a blocker stops `gates run` with exit 1 before any gate command runs. With no `HOME` the user's home folder is used, as Node does. A `--timeout-ms` over the 2147483647 ms timer limit runs with a 1 ms timer and prints Node's `TimeoutOverflowWarning`. A `--cwd` that is not a folder skips every gate, as Node does. An empty `--run` or `--block` prints Node's message with exit 1. A case Node also refuses is a one-line error with exit 1 or 2 that names the cause and the fix: a bad gate config (the same messages as config validation), a damaged run record, or `repeat_new_tests` on a block with no base commit. A command that cannot start is a red gate with reason `spawn-error`. Since B878 `gates run`, `gates detect` and the other `gates` subcommands refuse a flag they do not read (`--chnaged` for `--changed`, say) with `gates <sub>: unknown flag "<flag>"` and the usage on stderr, exit 2, before any config read or gate; before, `gates run` and `gates detect` ignored it and ran (exit 0). `version` with any argument prints `version: unknown flag "<flag>"` (or `unexpected argument`) and its usage, exit 2. | A gate command that is an executable file with no `#!` line (Node runs it with `/bin/sh` on Linux and stops with `spawn ENOEXEC` on macOS, B469; reason `gates-custom`); a run record whose `run_id` does not match `--run` (reason `gates-run-id-mismatch`), or with no `workspace` string (reason `gates-run-no-workspace`); also the `block land` gates step for these records. |
